note: Preparation-time classification of the 33 gate-to-class tagging gaps. Classification is a preparation judgment, not a result; the independent lead and the QPR-1 gate binding confirm it. JUSTIFIED NOT APPLICABLE requires justification_source. No row is created merely to fill a count.

gaps.rationale: The five-field differential gate needs exact-string membership negatives (case, substring, wildcard and near-miss members are not members). Oracles QO cover it and the grid has 5 near-miss members, but no negative-control row exists.
QG-01 compares old and new evaluator behaviour for the five Runtime fields; claim-carried identity is exercised under QG-06, QG-07, QG-10 and QG-11.
gaps.justification_source: gate statement in data/gate-definitions.json (from the P1 gate matrix), QG-01

gaps.rationale: Route A is out of V1 and earns no credit toward QG-01, QG-09 or QG-10; Route A rows are retained only for accidental-change detection.
gaps.justification_source: 03-differential-regression-test-plan.md section 3 and the approved Route B-only scope

gaps.rationale: QG-03 covers freshness bounds only; required-policy absence is QG-06.

gaps.rationale: A revoked selection must not be activated or resurrected; revocation controls on the activation path bear on the configuration-change gate.
An expired selection must not be activated; expiry controls on the activation path bear on the configuration-change gate.

gaps.rationale: Approval revival is owned by QG-03, QG-04 and QG-10; QG-08 covers revocation and expiry of selections.

gaps.rationale: Signature forgery is refused at verification and activation (QG-05, QG-12); QG-09 covers the policy enforced at commit, whose substitution controls are already tagged.
